events.name: CSRS-Europe 35th Hands-on Dissection & Instructional Course (Barcelona)
events.location: Hotel Catalonia, Barcelona, and Universidad de Barcelona Campus Bellvitge (L'Hospitalet de Llobregat), Spain
events.notes: Hands-on cadaveric dissection and instructional course for young spine surgeons: basic approaches, decompression and instrumentation of the cervical spine and its junctional zones, from the occiput to the high thoracic spine. Short lectures by CSRS-Europe board members plus hands-on instruction. 5 Nov (17:00–20:30): registration, lectures and course dinner at Hotel Catalonia, Barcelona. 6 Nov (8:30–17:00): dissection at the Sala de Disección, Universidad de Barcelona Campus Bellvitge, L'Hospitalet de Llobregat (transport provided). Hosted by Prof. Andrés Combalia. Registration fee €1,000 (per the event page).

events.name: CSRS-Europe Hands-on Specimen Course – Advanced Techniques & Surgical Skills (Salzburg)
events.notes: Advanced-level hands-on specimen course for spine surgeons: advanced techniques for complex cervical disorders (degeneration, trauma, infection, tumour, congenital anomalies, deformity). 4 Feb (14:30–19:00): lectures, peer discussion and course dinner. 5 Feb (9:00–17:00): hands-on cadaveric training at the Institute of Anatomy, Paracelsus Medical University Salzburg (Strubergasse 15). Hosted by Dr. Michael Mayer (Austria); co-chair Prof. Heiko Koller (Germany). Registration fee €990 (per the event page).

events.name: Endoscopic Skullbase Surgery in Children
events.subspecialty: Skull base surgery, Pediatric neurosurgery, Neuroendoscopy
events.location: Meyer Children's Hospital IRCCS (Meyer Health Campus), Florence, Italy
events.notes: Lecture-based congress with round tables (lectures and discussions in English; 100 participants) plus a hands-on pre-congress course on 19 Nov (simulation of the endoscopic endonasal approach on 3D-printed models of paediatric sellar tumours; mainly for neurosurgery, ENT and maxillofacial residents working in pairs; only the first 8 participants; €180). Scientific lead Lorenzo Genitori; scientific committee: Lorenzo Genitori, Mirko Scagnet, Federico Mussa, Filippo Giovannetti, Rina Agushi, Luca Spirito. Fees per the official poster: early bird until 15/09/2026 (passed) €150 members / €180 non-members (€130 residents, students, pediatricians); full fee €250 members / €280 non-members. Info and registration: ufficioformazione@meyer.it, 055 5662812. The poster shows a 'Call for abstracts' badge but no separate abstract deadline; its 15/09/2026 date belongs to the early-bird rate.

events.name: Sixteenth International Skull Base Dissection Course
events.location: ICLO Teaching and Research Center, Verona, Italy
events.sourceName: Neurosurgery Unit, San Filippo Neri Hospital (Rome) – Prof. L. Mastronardi
events.notes: Hands-on micro-neurosurgery dissection course (cadaver lab) organised by the International Association FRIENDS (Fronting Research & International Education in Neurosurgery Development and Sophistication) at ICLO, with an international faculty. Scientific lead: Luciano Mastronardi (Executive President of FRIENDS). Theme of this edition: advanced skull base approaches. Dates 7–9 October 2026, as announced by Prof. Mastronardi on https://www.neurologiachirurgica.it/chirurgia-della-base-del-cranio/advanced-skullbase-dissection/ (the ICLO page gives 3 days from 7 October). The FRIENDS dissection courses are part of the WFNS educational programme. In English, no ECM credits. Fee €2,150 VAT included (15% reduction for EANS members, max 3 places: €1,800), including 3 hotel nights (6, 7 and 8 October), 2 dinners, catering, material, one specimen for every two attendees, certificate and insurance. Read from the ICLO course page on 2026-10-01, which showed registration open.
